# FigS3A

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
library(imcRtools)

spe_S3_PC <- subset(spe, (Group == "S3_DF" | Group == "S3_R") & Location == Paracortex)
  
# By celltypes
spe_S3_PC <- aggregateNeighbors(spe_S3_PC, 
                          colPairName = "delaunay_interaction_graph", 
                          aggregate_by = "metadata", 
                          count_by = "celltype_level2")

set.seed(220705)

cn_1 <- kmeans(spe_S3_PC$aggregatedNeighbors, centers = 10, nstart = 100, iter.max = 1000)
spe_S3_PC$k10 <- as.factor(cn_1$cluster)

plotSpatial(spe_S3_PC[1], 
            node_color_by = "k10", 
            img_id = "sample_id", 
            node_size_fix = 1)

# Heatmap per group
spe_s3_PC_DF <- spe_S3_PC[,(spe_S3_PC$Group == "S3_DF")]
spe_s3_PC_DF <- spe_s3_PC_DF[,(spe_s3_PC_DF$cellcell_anno2 != "Tumor" & spe_s3_PC_DF$cellcell_anno2 != "Undefined")]

spe_s3_PC_R <- spe_S3_PC[,(spe_S3_PC$Group == "S3_R")]
spe_s3_PC_R <- spe_s3_PC_R[,(spe_s3_PC_R$cellcell_anno2 != "Tumor" & spe_s3_PC_R$cellcell_anno2 != "Undefined")]

library(pheatmap)
for_plot1 <- prop.table(table(spe_s3_PC_DF$k10, spe_s3_PC_DF$cellcell_anno2), 
                       margin = 2)
# Step 2: Convert to a data frame for easier manipulation
for_plot1_df <- as.data.frame(for_plot1)

# Step 3: Scale each column to a 0-1 range
for_plot1_df_scaled <- for_plot1_df %>%
  group_by(Var2) %>%  # assuming Var2 represents columns (i.e., cellcell_anno2 levels)
  mutate(Freq_scaled = (Freq - min(Freq)) / (max(Freq) - min(Freq))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 4: Optional: convert back to a table if necessary
for_plot1_scaled <- xtabs(Freq_scaled ~ Var1 + Var2, data = for_plot1_df_scaled)

for_plot2 <- prop.table(table(spe_s3_PC_R$k10, spe_s3_PC_R$cellcell_anno2), 
                       margin = 2)

# Step 2: Convert to a data frame for easier manipulation
for_plot2_df <- as.data.frame(for_plot2)

# Step 3: Scale each column to a 0-1 range
for_plot2_df_scaled <- for_plot2_df %>%
  group_by(Var2) %>%  # assuming Var2 represents columns (i.e., cellcell_anno2 levels)
  mutate(Freq_scaled = (Freq - min(Freq)) / (max(Freq) - min(Freq))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 4: Optional: convert back to a table if necessary
for_plot2_scaled <- xtabs(Freq_scaled ~ Var1 + Var2, data = for_plot2_df_scaled)

pheatmap(for_plot1_scaled, cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, 
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#005f73", "white", "#ae2012"))(100), 
         #color = colorRampPalette(c("#e3f2fd", "#42a5f5", "#0d47a1"))(100), 
         #scale = "column",
         number_format = "%.2f",  
         #display_numbers = TRUE,
         main = "PC_S3_DF")
pheatmap(for_plot2_scaled, cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, 
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#005f73", "white", "#ae2012"))(100), 
         #scale = "column", 
         main = "PC_S3_R")

```

# FigS3B

```{r}
meta = data.frame(Row.names = rownames(colData(spe_S3_PC)),
                  ROI.ID = spe_S3_PC$ROI.ID,
                  Group = spe_S3_PC$Group,
                  Location = spe_S3_PC$Location,
                  k10 = spe_S3_PC$k10,
                  area = spe_S3_PC$AreaShape_Area)

df <- meta %>% group_by(ROI.ID, k10, Group, Location) %>%
  reframe(Area = sum(area))

symnum.args <- list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))

for (i in 1:10) {

  p1 <- ggplot(
    subset(df, k10 == i),
    aes(x = Group, y = Area * 4, fill = Group)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.2,
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      aes(group = Group),
      comparisons = list(c("S3_DF", "S3_R")),
      method = "t.test",
      symnum.args = symnum.args
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("NB size per ROI - NB", i),
      x = "Variable",
      y = "um nb per mm2"
    ) +
    theme_classic()

  print(p1)
}
```

# FigS3C

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

df <- as.data.frame(colData(spe_S3_PC)) %>% 
  group_by(k10, cellcell_anno2, Group, Location) %>%
  reframe(n_k10 = n()) %>%
  complete(k10, cellcell_anno2, Group, Location, fill = list(n_k10 = 0)) %>%  # Fill missing rows with n_k10 = 0
  group_by(cellcell_anno2, Group, Location) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (n_k10 / sum(n_k10)) * 100) 

# Calculate the log2 fold change between groups
log2_fold_change_df <- df %>%
  group_by(k10, cellcell_anno2, Location) %>%
  reframe(
    log2FC = log2((percentage[Group == "S3_DF"]+1) / (percentage[Group == "S3_R"]+1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Load ggplot2 for visualization
library(ggplot2)

# Generate the heatmap
ggplot(log2_fold_change_df, aes(x = cellcell_anno2, y = k10, fill = log2FC)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +                       # Creates the heatmap with white tile borders
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#ae2012", mid = "white", high = "#005f73", midpoint = 0, 
                       name = "Log2 Fold Change") +   # Set color scale for log2 fold change
  theme_minimal() +                                  # Use a minimal theme
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +  # Rotate x-axis labels for clarity
  labs(x = "Cell Annotation (cellcell_anno2)",       # Customize axis labels
       y = "k10",
       title = "Heatmap of Log2 Fold Change by k10 and Cell Annotation")

```


# FigS3E

```{r, fig.width= 3, fig.height=5}

counts = as.data.frame(t(spe_S3_PC@assays@data$exprs))
meta = data.frame(Row.names = rownames(colData(spe_S3_PC)),
                  Group = spe_S3_PC$Group,
                  Location = spe_S3_PC$Location,
                  #celltype_res = spe_S3_PC$celltype_res2,
                  #celltype = spe_S3_PC$celltype,
                  cellcell_anno2 = spe_S3_PC$cellcell_anno2,
                  k10 = spe_S3_PC$k10,
                  ROI.ID = spe_S3_PC$ROI.ID)

df <- merge(meta, counts, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = "row.names")
rownames(df) <- df$Row.names
df <- dplyr::select(df, -c("Row.names"))

df2 <- df %>% group_by(ROI.ID, Location, Group, cellcell_anno2, k10) %>%
  summarize_all(mean)

markers = c("PD-1", "TOX", "TIM-3", "TCF1", "Ki-67", "IDO", "PD-L1", "CTLA-4")
cells <- c("CD8_nonNaive", "CD8_Naive", "Tregs_nonNaive", "HLADRhi_DC", "HLADRlo_DC", "M_CD163", "M_CD169")
symnum.args <- list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))

##########################################################

for (cell in cells){
  for (marker in markers){
p2 <- ggplot(subset(df2, (Group == "S3_DF" | Group == "S3_R") & Location == "Paracortex" & cellcell_anno2 == cell & k10 == "2"),
       aes_string(x="Group", y=paste0("`", marker,"`"), fill = "Group")) + 
       geom_violin() + geom_boxplot(width=0.1, fill="white") +
       #geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
       stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("S3_DF", "S3_R")), method = "t.test", symnum.args = symnum.args) +
       labs(title=paste0(cell, " - ", marker), x="Group", y = "mean normalized expression per ROI") + 
       scale_fill_manual(values = c("S3_DF" = "#00a1b1", "S3_R" = "#d85735")) + # Custom colors
       #scale_y_continuous(trans='log2') +
       theme_classic()
print(p2)
  }
}

```

# FigS3F-G

Here, we first calculate the interaction of each cell, summarised per ROI, and exported to be plotted using Graphpad Prism.

```{r}
library(BiocParallel)
library(imcRtools)
library(dplyr)

out <- testInteractions(spe, 
                        group_by = "ID",
                        label = "celltype_level2", 
                        colPairName = "delaunay_interaction_graph",
                        p_threshold = 0.05,
                        method = "classic", 
                        #patch_size = 3,
                        BPPARAM = SerialParam(RNGseed = 221029))

cc.df <- data.frame(out@listData)
cc.df$group = spe$Group[match(out@listData$group_by, spe$ID)]
cc.df$Location = spe$Location[match(out@listData$group_by, spe$ID)]
cc.df$Group.location = spe$Group.location[match(out@listData$group_by, spe$ID)]
cc.df$Patient = spe$Patient.ID[match(out@listData$group_by, spe$ID)]
cc.df$sig.int <- ifelse(cc.df$sigval == 1, "Interact", no = ifelse(cc.df$sigval == 0, "ns", "Avoid"))

cc.df <- cc.df %>% 
  group_by(Patient, from_label, to_label, group, Location) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_neighbours = mean(ct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_sigval = sum(sigval, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_interact = sum(str_detect(sig.int, "Interact"), na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_ns = sum(str_detect(sig.int, "ns"), na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_avoid = sum(str_detect(sig.int, "Avoid"), na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    percent.sigval = abs(sum_sigval/n), 
    interaction = if_else(sum_sigval < 0, "Avoid", "Interact")
  )

cc.sum <- data.frame(out@listData)
cc.sum$group = spe$Group[match(out@listData$group_by, spe$ID)]
cc.sum$Location = spe$Location[match(out@listData$group_by, spe$ID)]
cc.sum$Group.location = spe$Group.location[match(out@listData$group_by, spe$ID)]
cc.sum$Patient = spe$Patient.ID[match(out@listData$group_by, spe$ID)]

cc.sum <- cc.sum %>% 
  group_by(from_label, to_label, group, Location) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_neighbours = mean(ct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_sigval = sum(sigval, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    percent.sigval = abs(sum_sigval/n), 
    interaction = if_else(sum_sigval < 0, "Avoid", "Interact")
  )

write.table(cc.sum, "table_stat_cellcell_interact_boxplot.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
